dedupe_keys.name: superdarn ionospheric convection models from radar software toolkit rst

description: SuperDARN convection models estimate ionospheric electric potential from radar observations. The family includes historical and later statistical formulations using different radar networks and geomagnetic conditions. The resource is documented by Dartmouth College. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Some constituent models were derived only from Northern Hemisphere observations or restricted latitude bands. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.

discovery_routes.query: Complete model catalogue; select one version per model with stated space-weather infrastructure impacts

inputs: The model input parameters depend on which statistical model (RG96, PSR10, CS10, TS18, TS18-Kp) is chosen. The RG96 model varies only with the interplanetary magnetic field (IMF) B_y and B_z
